items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Herbie invited me to play.

ctx.x: Then the next one that shows up in the discography is in July of ’67. That’s Glory of Love, Herbie Mann’s date.
Right. I remember that date. That was at Rudy Van Gelder’s. I think Herbie invited me to play. I’m not sure. I can’t remember for sure.
